summary.en: The accent point lands on beat 1, shoots into a line that hands its colour to the ink, and the endpoint rises out of it as its baseline; one token swaps in on an accent chip.
summary.zh: 强调色的点在第 1 拍落下，射成一条线并把颜色交给墨色，接口路径从线上升起、以线为基线；其中一个记号换成强调色小片上的值。

fits: The hook of a film that promotes one shape; any opening on one line of code, a path or a command.
notFor: Prose openings; more than one line.

intent.en: A film opens on the smallest thing, a point, and promotes it into the first fact, so the viewer is inside the product's logic from frame one.
intent.zh: 片子从最小的东西——一个点——开场，把它升级成第一条事实，观众从第一帧起就在产品的逻辑里。

content.en: One line of code or a path (≤ 30 chars), an optional token swap [from, to], an optional note (≤ 36 / 14 字).
content.zh: 一行代码或路径（≤ 30 字符），可选的记号替换 [原, 新]，可选注释（≤ 36 字符 / 14 字）。

fits.zh: 把一个形状逐级升级的片子的钩子；任何以一行代码、路径或命令开场的片子。

pairs.note: thickens its line into a pill

en: Keep the line under 30 characters; at 69 px a longer line leaves the safe area.
zh: 这一行不超过 30 字符；69 px 字号下再长就出安全区。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
